prompt: A space station observation deck floats above Earth, its panoramic window showing swirling clouds below. Inside, four astronauts in white suits float near a central control panel covered in blinking lights and touchscreens. Two robotic arms extend through airlocks, each gripping a data tablet and a camera. A cluster of cables connects to a cylindrical oxygen tank next to a toolbox packed with wrenches and screwdrivers. Five life-support modules line the wall opposite three storage lockers. Floating notebooks and pens drift past a holographic star chart display. A small potted plant in a transparent container bobs gently beside an emergency beacon. There is no Earth globe, no oil lamp, no wooden crate, no paper map, and no handheld mirror.
